summary.text: Stephanie White is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican David Osborne.
A high school math teacher and small business owner, she holds a Ph.D. from the University of Louisville and won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie White earned a bachelor's degree from Wake Forest University in 2000, a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Dallas in 2024, and a Ph.D. from the University of Louisville in 2024.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has a Ph.D. in Curriculum and Instruction, founded online family resources LouisvilleFamilyFun.net and OldhamFamilyFun.net, and has worked in digital media, marketing, and public relations for over 15 years.
She said she currently serves as a high school math teacher.
White defeated Pandora Sears in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary, 80.5% to 19.5%.
In the survey, she named affordability for families, increased state funding for schools and teacher salaries, and affordable high-quality healthcare as her key campaign messages.
